name: whatsapp-skill-tools
description: WhatsApp AI Agent Tools Definition using Baileys and pairing-code auth

tools.name: connectWhatsApp
tools.description: Connect to WhatsApp using a phone number and request an 8-character pairing code. Returns the code to enter in WhatsApp on the phone (Settings > Linked Devices > Link a Device > Link with phone number instead).

phoneNumber.description: The WhatsApp phone number including country code with no punctuation (e.g., '15551234567' or '+1 555 123 4567').

tools.name: getConnectionStatus
tools.description: Check current WhatsApp connection status, active linked phone number, pairing state, or last error.

tools.name: getPairingCode
tools.description: Get the active WhatsApp pairing code and step-by-step pairing instructions if waiting for pairing.

tools.name: getChats
tools.description: List recent conversations / chats with unread counts and latest messages.

limit.description: Maximum number of chats to return (default: 50).

isGroup.description: Filter for groups (true) or private 1:1 chats (false).

tools.name: searchChats
tools.description: Search chats by contact or group name.

query.description: Search keyword for chat name or JID.

tools.name: searchContacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name, notify name, or phone number.

query.description: Search keyword for contact name or phone number.

tools.name: readMessages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a specific WhatsApp chat.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to fetch (default: 20).

before.description: ISO date string or timestamp to fetch messages before.

tools.name: searchMessages
tools.description: Powerful multi-filter message search using local SQLite index and FTS5 full-text search. Supports keyword, sender, recipient, chat, group, date range, message type, attachments, and read status.

query.description: Text keyword or search terms across message text, captions, and filenames.

exactPhrase.description: Exact phrase to match in message text.

sender.description: Filter by sender JID or partial phone number.

chat.description: Filter by chat JID or chat name (e.g. 'ABC School' or group name).

isGroup.description: Filter for group messages (true) or private messages (false).

hasAttachment.description: Filter messages with attachments (true) or without (false).

isRead.description: Filter by read (true) or unread (false) status.

messageId.description: Specific message ID to look up.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 20, max: 200).

sort.description: Sort direction by timestamp: 'desc' (newest first) or 'asc' (oldest first).

tools.name: getMessage
tools.description: Get full details of a specific message by its message ID, including sender, chat, text, and attachment metadata.

tools.name: sendMessage
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text message to a contact or group.

to.description: Recipient phone number (e.g. '+15551234567') or group JID ('12345@g.us').

text.description: The text message body to send.

quotedMessageId.description: Optional message ID to quote / reply to.

tools.name: replyToMessage
tools.description: Reply directly to a specific WhatsApp message by its message ID.

messageId.description: The message ID being replied to.

tools.name: downloadAttachment
tools.description: Download and decrypt a media attachment from a message (image, video, document, voice note, PDF, etc.). Returns the local file path.

messageId.description: The ID of the message containing the attachment to download.

tools.name: sendAttachment
tools.description: Send a file or media attachment (image, video, audio, voice note, PDF, document) to a recipient or group.

to.description: Recipient phone number (e.g. '+15551234567') or group JID.

file.description: Local file path to the attachment on disk.

caption.description: Optional caption text for images, videos, or documents.

mediaType.description: Optional media type. If omitted, it will be automatically inferred from the file extension.

fileName.description: Custom filename to display to the recipient (especially for documents).

quotedMessageId.description: Optional message ID to quote with this attachment.

tools.name: replyWithAttachment
tools.description: Reply to a specific WhatsApp message with a file or media attachment.

messageId.description: The message ID being replied to.

file.description: Local file path to the attachment on disk.
